test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following state governments announced a four-year mentorship programme called 'Project Arohan', to provide guidance to students and improve their skills, in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Assam__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Assam government has launched a four-year mentorship programme called Project Arohan to provide guidance to students and hone their skills.
 
• For this, Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma met Anita Rajan, CEO of Tata STRIVE, a skill development initiative of Tata Trusts in February 2022, and sought their cooperation for the project.
 
• 
 
"Aarohan," a website portal has already been launched.
